recipes.notes: Tested 2026-09-18 on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 (glibc 2.39), as a normal user, amd64 builds of 0.12.18, io.js 1.8.4 and 3.3.1, 4.9.1, 8.17.0, 12.22.12, 16.20.2, 20.20.2, 22.23.2, 26.9.0: unpacked under a path containing spaces, node -v, npm -v, 'npm install is-number' into a project folder with spaces and require() it, 'npm install -g' (landed in {runtime_dir}/lib/node_modules), npx --version; HOME pointed at an empty folder stayed empty with etc/npmrc in place (without it npm wrote ~/.npm/_cacache, _logs, _update-notifier-last-checked); a hostile ~/.npmrc setting prefix/cache was ignored with --userconfig; two copies of 26.9.0 and 0.12.18 side by side; a copy renamed after install still ran. x86/arm/ppc/s390x archives are the same layout but were not run. io.js archives ship bin/iojs with bin/node as a symlink. npm config: prefix defaults to the folder above bin/node (POSIX) or the node.exe folder (Windows), so -g installs and the global npmrc ({prefix}/etc/npmrc) land inside {runtime_dir}. The one default that escapes is the cache (~/.npm on POSIX, %LocalAppData%\npm-cache for npm>=5 / %APPDATA%\npm-cache for npm<=4 on Windows, also holding _logs and the update-notifier stamp); the etc/npmrc step moves it inside. --userconfig pointing at a file that need not exist stops a user's ~/.npmrc (which outranks the global npmrc) from redirecting prefix/cache; it must NOT be the same file as etc/npmrc (npm>=7 refuses: 'double-loading config'). A project's own .npmrc is still honoured. Call npm as node + npm-cli.js: the bin/npm and bin/npx shims of npm>=3 are '#!/usr/bin/env node' symlinks and fail unless {runtime_dir}/bin is on PATH (tested). Scripts installed into node_modules/.bin also use '/usr/bin/env node', so the app launcher should put {runtime_dir}/bin (Windows: {runtime_dir}) first on PATH for the app's own process. npx: "{runtime_dir}/bin/node" "{runtime_dir}/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npx-cli.js" (npm>=5.2, node>=8). etc/npmrc holds an absolute cache path: if the folder were ever moved, rewrite it (design says folders never move).

recipes.notes: Inspected the downloaded 16.20.2 and 26.9.0 .pkg files: a flat xar product archive with two components, node-vX.pkg and npm-vY.pkg, both relocatable=false, payload = gzip'd odc cpio rooted at ./usr/local (bin/node, include/, lib/node_modules/, share/). npm's preinstall only rm -rf's /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm and its postinstall only makes the bin/npm and bin/npx symlinks, recreated above. Running 'installer -pkg' is NOT usable: fixed target /usr/local, registers org.nodejs.node.pkg receipts (once per machine) and would clobber a system Node.
